experiment: exp10 Drift-Adapter faithful reproduction + factor analysis

protocol_stated.direction: new query -> old space, old index unchanged

adapters.MLP: 1 hidden layer 256, GELU, dropout 0.1, residual, DSM

protocol_stated.pairs: Np=20,000 random database docs; 5 runs, fresh sample each
protocol_stated.metrics: Recall@10, MRR, ARR = system / re-embedded system

our_choices_not_stated.dim_mismatch: rectangular Procrustes R=UV^T; MLP skip = fixed R
our_choices_not_stated.mrr: MRR@10 of the true nearest neighbour
our_choices_not_stated.database: full training split where 1M exceeds it
